title: Raise G20 ordinary BIT saving to0.003507719059749 with scalar conjugations
body:

Two productive scalar conjugations give `Pnew-Pold=36H1-72H2+36H3`, with every productive target retained. This is a component improvement, not a new whole multiplication kappa.

Base: canonical main `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `829d01fc031f7323ffcfa423fdfd1f24dcbe3190`.

Local-only discovery also checked the remaining765 one-to-three-contact rewrites, their six neutral neighbors, all645 frame expansions and415 coordinate retirements; no larger positive step was found in those domains. These are not global-optimum claims.

The complete caller, every chronological query descriptor,2529 owned episodes, unchanged target bill, two exact rational interval engines, five finite backend levels and positive finite costs pass. Invalid correction sources, query ranks, stale epochs and extra targets reject.
